title: Attendance
subtitle: Staff clock-ins and clock-outs. They are recorded on the venue terminal or app; here you review them.

empty.title: No clock-ins in this period
empty.description: Staff clock in and out from the venue terminal or app.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this clock-in?
rejectDialog.description: Say why you are rejecting {{name}}'s entry. The reason is saved.
rejectDialog.placeholder: e.g. the photo is not from this location

toasts.errorDesc: Please try again in a moment.

empty.title: Nothing to report for this period
empty.description: People with a schedule who were late, absent or left early show up here. Without a schedule nobody is judged.

disabled.title: Attendance tracking is off
disabled.description: Staff cannot clock in while it is off. What was already recorded stays here.

loadError.title: Could not load
loadError.description: Something went wrong fetching this data. It does not mean there is nothing to show.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.subtitle: Period numbers, payroll-ready. Vacation and leave are not absences.
payroll.empty: No staff activity in this period.
